title: Understanding the Relationship
text: Consider how the relationship between age and Netflix watch time might be transformed to a linear one. Think about common transformations like logarithms or square roots.

title: Logarithmic Transformation
text: A logarithmic transformation can help linearize relationships where one variable grows exponentially compared to another. Consider applying a logarithm to the age variable.

title: Transforming the Variables
text: If you apply a logarithmic transformation to the age variable, what would the new variables look like?
